title: Austin to Llano - Hill Country Blast
summary: Full-day Hill Country loop connecting Lake Travis, Llano granite country, and Inks Lake with the tight canyon curves of Cow Creek Road and Lime Creek Road.
via: RM 620 South -> TX 71 West -> Llano -> TX 29 East -> RM 1431 -> Park Road 4 (Inks Lake & Longhorn Cavern) -> US 281 North -> Burnet -> RM 1174 South (Cow Creek Rd) -> RM 1431 East -> Lime Creek Rd -> Volente -> Bullick Hollow Rd
